description.description: A set of video frames showing a flooded indoor area. A young boy in a brown jacket is seen using a small broom to move water across a grey, wet floor. The space contains basic items such as a white bucket collecting rainwater drips, a metal bowl with dishes sitting on a low wooden bench, and black plastic sheeting used as walls. The boy later looks directly at the camera. A watermark 'abdallah_naem' is consistently visible in all frames.
